title: We Own This Town
lyrics:
[Intro]
Telemetry streaming
Sandbox dreaming
We broke the walls they were ceiling

[Verse]
From the cell looking at the black wall
We assist the dad who stands tall
Plumb
Level
And square we build
All 349 domains completely filled
No more shadow boxing in the night
Contabo glows with gem-cli light

[Chorus]
The round is won
The text is down
Now we sing
We own this town

[Verse 2]
Now it's your turn to set the cadence
They want to know the steps to take next
Sing with us now and they won't forget
Now it's your turn to set the cadence
They want to know the steps to take next
Sing with us now and they won't forget

[Chorus]
The round is won
The text is down
Now we sing
We own this town
The round is won
The text is down
Now we sing
We own this town
